_comment: Copy to discord_config.json and chmod 600. Never commit the real file.
_setup: 2. Bot tab -> Reset Token -> copy it into bot_token below
3. Bot tab -> enable the MESSAGE CONTENT INTENT toggle
4. OAuth2 -> URL Generator -> scopes: bot -> permissions: View Channels + Read Message History
5. Open that URL and add the bot to a server where YOU have Manage Server
6. In Discord: User Settings -> Advanced -> enable Developer Mode
7. Right-click each channel -> Copy Channel ID -> add below
